page.layout: One title page, all centred, in one block of lines. A printed rule separates the title from the Roman numeral XXXVII. Below the title block: an engraved woodcut (a tree with figures beneath it), then the motto "IESVS." and a Bible quotation in italic, then the imprint in capitals at the foot. No running head, no page number, no notes in the margins.

l.i: Accessit operi Index rerum præcipuarum, quæ in his homiliis continentur.

main_text.l: Calend. Maij, Anno M. D. LXII.

page.notes: The woodcut between the title and "IESVS." shows a tree with figures at its base and a town in the background; it is an illustration, not text. The small handwritten "2" at the top right is not printed and is left out. "Ioann. I." is set in small italic capitals and read as I. with some doubt.
